situation: Large Chinese investment-caster for which we are a tiny account (0.12 % of turnover). It supplies 40 % of HI 250 impellers at 79.44, about 6.5 % below our model of its own plant (cost:310051) and a third cheaper than Allgäu-Reiter. It keeps buying volume below cost, and it now asks to be paid in 10 days instead of 90. The yuan gained ~8 % on the euro in 12 months, which squeezes its EUR margins further. Expect a push to raise price; cash timing is the cheap answer.
